tracesTo: UserFlow: Weekly Member Engagement, Feed Interaction, Pick'ems & History Browsing

stories.title: Automatically Grade Picks After Stat Corrections
stories.goal: ensure picks are graded only after official stat corrections are finalized
stories.benefit: grading is accurate and reflects final official results without premature scoring
acceptanceCriteria: System monitors for stat correction completion signals from fantasy platform API
Grading process does not run until stat corrections are marked as final
System automatically triggers grading when corrections are complete
Previously graded picks are re-evaluated if stat corrections change matchup outcomes
Grading timestamp reflects stat-correction-finalized time, not game end time
System logs all grading events with timestamps and correction status

stories.title: Calculate Correct vs Incorrect Picks for Each User
stories.goal: see which of my picks were correct and incorrect for a completed week
stories.benefit: I can evaluate my prediction accuracy and understand my performance
acceptanceCriteria: System compares each user's pick against final matchup winner after stat corrections
Each pick is marked as correct (green) or incorrect (red) with clear visual indicator
User can view their graded picks on matchups page for completed weeks
System displays total correct picks out of total picks made for the week
Percentage accuracy is calculated and displayed (e.g., '6/10 correct - 60%')
Non-participating users show no picks and no grading for that week

stories.title: Track Weekly Pick'ems Stats Per User
stories.goal: view my performance stats for each individual week
stories.benefit: I can analyze my week-by-week prediction accuracy and track improvement
acceptanceCriteria: System stores weekly stats including correct picks, total picks, and accuracy percentage
User can view their own weekly stats history in profile or dedicated stats page
Weekly stats display week number, correct/total picks, percentage, and rank for that week
Stats reflect only matchups that were picked by the user (partial participation supported)
System calculates weekly rank among all participants based on correct pick count
Weekly stats are finalized only after all matchups are graded post-stat-corrections

stories.title: Calculate Season-Long Pick'ems Stats
stories.goal: see my cumulative pick'ems performance across all weeks of the current season
stories.benefit: I can track my overall season accuracy and compare to previous seasons
acceptanceCriteria: System aggregates all weekly pick results into season totals
Season stats include total correct picks, total picks made, overall accuracy percentage
Season stats display current season's data with clear season identifier
User can view season stats on their profile or leaderboard
Season stats update after each week's grading is completed
System calculates season rank among all participants based on cumulative correct picks or accuracy

stories.title: Track All-Time Pick'ems Stats Across All Seasons
stories.goal: view my pick'ems performance across all seasons I've participated in
stories.benefit: I can see my legacy and long-term prediction skills
acceptanceCriteria: System maintains historical stats for all completed seasons
All-time stats include total correct picks, total picks, and overall accuracy across all seasons
User can view breakdown by season in their all-time stats view
All-time stats are separate from current season stats with clear labeling
System supports dynasty leagues with continuous history and redraft leagues with season-by-season history
All-time leaderboard ranks users by cumulative correct picks or highest average accuracy

stories.title: View Separate Manager Leaderboard
stories.goal: see how I rank among other managers in pick'ems performance
stories.benefit: I can compete with fellow managers who have similar league knowledge and investment
acceptanceCriteria: System maintains separate leaderboard filtering for users with Manager role
Manager leaderboard displays username, total correct picks, accuracy percentage, and rank
Leaderboard supports sorting by correct picks (descending) or accuracy percentage
Manager leaderboard shows both current season and all-time stats views
System filters users by role (excludes Fans and Admins from Manager leaderboard)
Leaderboard updates automatically after each week's grading

stories.title: View Separate Fan Leaderboard
stories.goal: see how I rank among other fans in pick'ems performance
stories.benefit: I can compete with other fans in a fair comparison without managers who have insider advantages
acceptanceCriteria: System maintains separate leaderboard filtering for users with Fan role
Fan leaderboard displays username, total correct picks, accuracy percentage, and rank
Leaderboard supports sorting by correct picks or accuracy percentage
Fan leaderboard shows both current season and all-time stats views
System filters users by role (excludes Managers and Admins from Fan leaderboard)
Leaderboard updates automatically after each week's grading

stories.title: Display Cumulative Records on Leaderboard
stories.goal: see win-loss records in addition to raw correct pick counts
stories.benefit: I can understand performance in familiar sports record format (e.g., 45-23)
acceptanceCriteria: System calculates cumulative record as [correct picks]-[incorrect picks] for each user
Leaderboard displays records in format 'W-L' (e.g., '45-23') alongside accuracy percentage
Record reflects only weeks with participation (non-picked matchups not counted as losses)
Season records and all-time records are displayed separately with clear labels
System sorts leaderboard by total correct picks (wins) as primary, accuracy as tiebreaker
Records update automatically after each grading cycle

stories.title: View My Personal Stats Summary
stories.goal: access a dashboard showing my pick'ems performance across all timeframes
stories.benefit: I can quickly understand my prediction skills and progress at a glance
acceptanceCriteria: User can access personal stats page or widget showing weekly, season, and all-time stats
Summary displays correct/total picks, accuracy percentage, and record for each timeframe
Personal stats show current rank on both Manager and Fan leaderboards (if applicable)
Stats include visual indicators like charts or progress bars for accuracy
System displays recent week performance and improvement trends
Personal stats page links to detailed weekly history and leaderboards

stories.title: Handle Partial Week Participation in Stats
stories.user: League Member Who Picked Some But Not All Matchups
stories.goal: have my stats reflect only the matchups I actually picked
stories.benefit: my accuracy is calculated fairly based on games I chose to predict
acceptanceCriteria: System calculates stats based only on matchups user submitted picks for
Unpicked matchups are not counted as incorrect or included in total picks
Stats display both correct picks and total picks made to show participation level
Leaderboard allows comparison based on accuracy percentage regardless of participation level
System clearly indicates participation rate (e.g., '8/10 matchups picked this week')
Partial participation does not penalize user's accuracy percentage

stories.title: View Comparative Stats Against League Average
stories.goal: see how my performance compares to the league average
stories.benefit: I can gauge if I'm above or below average in prediction skill
acceptanceCriteria: System calculates league-wide average accuracy for each week and season
User stats display comparison indicator showing percentage above or below average
Comparative stats are shown for weekly, season, and all-time performance
League average excludes non-participants from calculation
Visual indicator (e.g., color, badge) shows if user is above, at, or below average
Comparative stats update after each grading cycle

stories.title: Detect and Handle Stat Correction Impact on Grading
stories.goal: identify when stat corrections change matchup outcomes and regrade accordingly
stories.benefit: pick'ems results remain accurate and fair even when official scores change
acceptanceCriteria: System monitors matchup scores before and after stat correction window
System detects if stat corrections flip winner/loser of any matchup
Affected picks are automatically regraded with updated outcome
Users are notified if their picks were affected by stat correction changes
Historical grading logs show original and corrected grades with timestamps
Leaderboards reflect updated grades after stat correction regrading
